text:
jane-support: FYI customer ACME hitting intermittent 429s on their Dedicated pool since this morning. They say it started right after we applied their new quota.

mike-oncall: Can you paste the exact 429 body and the quota payload we applied?

jane-support: 429 body: `{\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\", \"retry_after\": 15}`. We applied quota via UI earlier: shown in ticket — they requested 3600 u/min but the UI shows 600 u/min now. I grabbed the applied config:
```
redwoodctl get-quota --tenant acme --output json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "quota": {
    "units_per_minute": 600,
    "burst": 1200
  }
}
```

jane-support: They claim they set 3600. Possible UI/save bug?

mike-oncall: devops-bot, any autoscaler/quotas events for acme around 08:10 UTC?
\devops-bot: [autoscaler] 2035000207 - pool-dedicated-3: scale_down prevented by per-tenant rate limit config for tenant=acme; current_rate=3500u/min, configured_limit=600u/min.
\lucy-tenant-eng: That log suggests the applied quota is indeed 600 and hitting the token bucket. Two likely causes: (1) the save flow coerced units_per_minute to the plan default (typo in UI mapping) or (2) units were uploaded in units_per_hour and server interpreted as per_minute. Can we check audit logs?
\jane-support: Audit shows update by `psmith` at 08:09 with payload: `{\"units_per_hour\": 216000}` — looks like the UI form had hours field but server expects per_minute. If we accidentally map hours -> per_minute we could set 216000 u/min which would be huge — but that's not what we see. Strange.
\mike-oncall: Hmm. Another possibility: quota write succeeded but a later job rolled back to plan default (600) because a feature flag prevented custom quotas from applying to Dedicated pools. Check rollout flags.
\samira-ops: I queried the quota service: `GET /internal/quotas/tenant/acme` -> returned the 600 config. I also dumped rate-limiter token state: `redis-cli HGETALL token_buckets:acme` -> `tokens: 0`, `last_refill: 2035000189`. So the bucket exhausted and refill rate matches 600/min.
\lucy-tenant-eng: Repro steps for us: 1) simulate 200 concurrent small requests against their pool for 2 minutes 2) watch 429 increase 3) check `redwoodctl get-quota`. I can run a quick smoke.
\jane-support: Customer already provided traces showing spike at 08:12 with many short requests.
\mike-oncall: Temporary mitigation: (A) increase quota to intended value, (B) enable burst routing to fallback dedicated pool, or (C) enable graceful fallback to hosted tier. Which is fastest?
\samira-ops: Fastest is updating quota via API. Command: `redwoodctl update-quota --tenant acme --units-per-minute 3600 --burst 7200`. I can run that with an audit note. Also need to flush token bucket so they don't wait for refill: `redis-cli HSET token_buckets:acme tokens 3600 last_refill <now>` (or delete key to force regen).
\mike-oncall: Do it and monitor 5-10m. Also add a temporary routing rule to allow acme to borrow from quiet pool: `routingctl add-override --tenant acme --fallback-pool pool-dedicated-burst`
\samira-ops: Patch applied at 2035000289: ran update-quota and HSET to refill tokens. Routing override added at 2035000302. Audit note: "emergency quota increase after misapplied UI update".
\jane-support: Customer reporting immediate improvement: error rate dropped from 18% to 1% in 2 minutes. They said :thumbsup:.
\lucy-tenant-eng: Marking as likely root cause = quota rollback/mapping bug in UI-to-api mapping. Filing internal bug: `ENG-QUOTA-1942`. Need postmortem: - how did audit show `units_per_hour` in payload? - why did config end up 600? - add server-side validation for mismatched fields.
\mike-oncall: Also add an alert for large divergence between requested quota and applied quota for the same tenant.
\jane-support: I'll follow up with customer with timeline and mitigation steps. Can ops/infra confirm a fix plan?
\samira-ops: Backfill: we traced a scheduled job at 2035000240 that applied plan defaults during a partial rollout of quota-feature-flag. The job incorrectly matched acme and overwrote their custom quota. Will revert rollout and add guard rails.
\lucy-tenant-eng: Thanks. I'll own the bug and coordinate the postmortem.
\jane-support: Closing loop with customer and will update ticket when postmortem lands. :white_check_mark:
